name: m3il
description: m3il — encrypted, local-first web mail client for any provider (Void Mail by VoidSuite)

scripts.install:all: cd client && bun install && cd ../server && bun install
scripts.dev: echo 'Run in two terminals: bun run dev:server and bun run dev:client'
scripts.typecheck: cd client && bunx tsc -b && cd ../server && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run lint
